title.value: An Act concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes
title.provenance: AN ACT concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes.

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means substances that include any member of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: a. Beginning two years after the effective date of this act, no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS.

date.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act

who.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act, no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS.

action.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act, no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS.

products.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act, no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS.

value: Class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto, including, but not limited to, 14 C.F.R. s.139.317.
exceptions.provenance: Subsection a. of this section shall not apply to the sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto, including, but not limited to, 14 C.F.R. s.139.317. If a federal requirement to include PFAS in class B firefighting foam is revoked, subsection a. of this section shall apply one year after the requirement is revoked.

intentionally_added.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act, no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS.
